info.title: School SaaS API
info.description:
## School Management SaaS API

### Authentication
Sign in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login` and send the returned access token as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

### Multi-Tenancy
Every school is a tenant. Send its id in `X-Tenant-ID` on tenant-scoped requests.

### Versioning
The API is versioned in the URL path: `/api/v1/...`

### Idempotency
Endpoints that create records or move money require an `Idempotency-Key` header, so a retried
request is applied once.

### Errors
Failures return `success: false` with a machine-readable `error.code` and an `error.traceId`
that matches the `X-Request-Id` response header — quote it when reporting a problem.
